note: Designed sounds for House Ealdholt's opening, as it is now: the watch before dawn, the low run, the leap and the dive, the climb, the spiral round the church, the rise and the forged title. There is no voice: the music carries the film and these sit under it, few and quiet as the creator prefers (see the prologue's plan). 'at' is seconds on the film's clock (film/src/world/timeline.js TIMES; the title's moments are tools/title.html's, 24.8 s plus its own clock). 'gain' is dB applied to the sound once tools/stable_sfx.py has brought its peak to -1 dBFS; 'in' and 'out' are fades in seconds; 'peak' places a sound's loudest moment at that film time; 'check' and 'not' are what earshot must and must not hear (tools/listen_sfx.py). To be made with Stable Audio 3.0 Small SFX (Soundbox + audio.cpp). Generated on 13 November 2026: the sounds and their records in audio/sfx_sa/ (plan.json, and earshot's verdicts in check.json), the chosen music take and its placement in audio/music/pick.json, the mix in audio/ealdholt-opening-mix.m4a.
